dedupe_keys.name: an online tool for semantic driven wsis

description: Eurecat describes an implemented initial online tool called RIOTER that explores semantically enriched industrial-symbiosis information. Its published WSIS ontology represents industrial processes and exchanges of water, material and energy, with performance indicators and context needed to assess alternative symbiosis strategies. The initial ontology and tool use process information from Nieuw Prinsenland. The ontology is a named linked information component of the described tool; the catalogue does not infer a numerical simulation solver from semantic browsing. The report establishes implementation and decision functions, but availability of a working service, source code and software licence remains unknown. The source describes the stated resource-recovery analysis. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
